غَلَفٌ inf. n. of غَلِفَ [q. v.]: (Msb:) [as a simple subst.,] The state of being uncircumcised. (S, O, K.) ―
-b2- [Also, of the heart, (assumed tropical:) The state of being أَغْلَف: so, app., accord. to the TA: in the L written غَلَفَة.] ―
-b3- And (assumed tropical:) Ample abundance of herbage, or of the goods, conveniences, or comforts, of life. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
